question: The critical angle ($i_c$) is a specific angle of incidence in the denser medium. What is the behavior of the refracted ray when the angle of incidence is exactly equal to this critical angle?

options.A: It is reflected back into the denser medium
options.B: It passes undeviated into the rarer medium
options.C: It grazes the surface of separation (angle of refraction = $90^\circ$)
options.D: It emerges normal to the surface
